obsidian hotkeys outputs tab-separated lines: command ID in column 1, key binding (if any) in column 2. Unmapped commands have an empty second field. awk -F'\t' '$2' prints only lines where the second field is truthy (non-empty).

What Obsidian tools are there for integrating with Atlassian Jira to easily make a digital twin of any ticket?

Short answer: There is no official Obsidian↔Jira product integration. For a per-ticket digital twin (a real note in the vault that mirrors Jira fields and stays queryable in the graph), prioritize Jira Shadow; for edit-in-Obsidian, push-back-to-Jira twins, use Jira Issue Manager (plugin id jira-sync, repo Alamion/obsidian-jira-sync). Jira Issue (marc0l92/obsidian-jira-issue) is the mature choice for live embeds in notes, not one markdown file per issue.
